"""Independently recompute every unchanged held-out outcome and candidate metric."""
import gzip,hashlib,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path('/home/josh/projects/klem');sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'tools'))
from reported_deoni_corpora import verify_rows
from copula_expectation_production import read,sha
path=Path('/tmp/klem-reported-dana-prototype-corpora.json.gz');current=read(path)
previous=read('docs/reported-deoni-prototype-corpora.json.gz')
assert current['inputs_unchanged'] and current['previous_report_sha256']==sha(ROOT/'docs/reported-deoni-prototype-corpora.json.gz')
assert current['after_words']==previous['after_words'] and len(current['after_words'])==32096
assert current['changed_words']=={} and current['candidate_changes']==[] and current['actual_prior_companions']=={}
assert current['after_word_sha256']==hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(current['after_words'],ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()
assert hashlib.sha256(current['producer']['text'].encode()).hexdigest()==current['producer']['sha256']
assert len(current['corpora'])==len(previous['corpora'])==4
checks=[]
for actual,old in zip(current['corpora'],previous['corpora'],strict=True):
 assert all(actual[k]==old[k] for k in ['corpus','partition','source','source_sha256','report_lines'])
 assert actual['exit_code']==0 and actual['command'][1:]==[actual['corpus'],actual['source']]
 assert actual['before_jsonl']==old['after_jsonl']
 rows=[json.loads(line) for line in actual['after_jsonl'].splitlines()]
 before=[json.loads(line) for line in actual['before_jsonl'].splitlines()]
 assert rows==before and len(rows)==actual['report_lines']
 assert actual['changed_gold_outcomes']==[] and actual['changed_summary_fields']=={}
 assert sha(ROOT/actual['source'])==actual['source_sha256']==hashlib.sha256(actual['original_source_text'].encode()).hexdigest()
 for summary in [rows[0],before[0]]:assert summary['input_sha256']==actual['source_sha256'] and summary['input']==actual['source']
 checks.append({'corpus':actual['corpus'],'partition':actual['partition'],'before':verify_rows(before,previous['after_words']),'after':verify_rows(rows,current['after_words'])})
assert sum(r['after']['rows'] for r in checks)==66570
p=Path(__file__);output=Path('/tmp/klem-reported-dana-prototype-corpora-audit.json');assert not output.exists()
output.write_text(json.dumps({'schema_version':1,'state':'passed','capture_sha256':sha(path),'prior_sha256':sha(ROOT/'docs/reported-deoni-prototype-corpora.json.gz'),'checks':checks,'producer':{'text':p.read_text(),'sha256':sha(p)}},indent=2)+'\n')
print('Independently verified all66570 unchanged annotated outcomes and ambiguity summaries; all32096 complete word outputs unchanged.')
